It is not five independent confirmations. It counts as one primary-source analysis (the H1 statements and the 6-Ks), which agents 2, 4 and 5 checked themselves. Agent_3 says it could not parse the H1 statements and relied on the supervisor's reading. Agent_1 ran no new research beyond the close. The remaining spread is real and independent: the operating multiple (1.5x to 4x), the size of deployments ($55-70M), and whether to deduct leakage. I re-verified the underlying facts in the primary filings this round, so the anchor is accurate, but agreement on it should not be read as extra confidence.

disagreements.resolution: ~$355M (range $320-390M). Verified: cash $479.8M + restricted $6.3M = $486.1M at 30-Jun-2026, working capital $485.7M, H1 op cash -$23.7M, investing -$22.3M (Quobly -$17.5M, SAFE -$6.0M), interest income $6.2M. Less ~$12M Q3 burn and the $10.0M SAIQ PIPE (926,784 shares at $10.79, closed Oct 1) gives ~$464M now. Less ~$50M burn and ~$55M of deployments gives ~$355M. Interest income will shrink as cash is spent, so $50-55M of burn is right. The $6.3M of restricted cash sits with Wecan (a consolidated subsidiary with a $7.5M non-controlling interest), so it is not fully SEALSQ's. The spread between agents is within estimation noise.

disagreements.positions: agent_5 1.5x; agent_3 2x (SOTP) and 5x (EV/sales); agent_2 3.5x; agents 1 and 4 4x (agent_4 also 3x in its SOTP).
disagreements.resolution: About 2.5-3x on ~$42M. At $2.375 x 231M = $549M, less ~$464M cash and ~$45M of stakes (book), the market prices the operations at only ~$40-90M EV (about 1.3-3x FY26). This business loses ~$60M a year at the operating line, and from Oct-2027 on the forward-cash method charges no further burn, so a 4x multiple double-credits the business. The 1.5x floor ignores the PQC certification optionality. Each turn of the multiple is worth ~$0.18/share, which makes this the biggest remaining driver of the $1.98-2.20 spread.

disagreements.resolution: Confirmed in the Sep-25 6-K. Three details matter. (1) The October and January items are lab test reports, not certifications; the Sep-24 release puts formal Common Criteria EAL5+ certification only in '2027 ... subject to certification-authority review'. (2) The Aug-14 6-K said 'expects first commercial revenues from QVault TPM products by the end of 2026'; the Sep-24/25 filings drop that sentence and the FIPS 140-3 dates, and change 'expects' to 'targets'. (3) Products remain engineering samples. The VaultIC408 FIPS 140-3 Level 3 certificate (#5463, Aug 5, 2026) covers classical crypto only. PQC revenue is an H2-2027 story at best.

Twelve Data confirms the 2026-10-02 bar: O 2.429, H 2.45, L 2.36, C 2.375, volume 6.98M. The $2.425 in the brief is roughly the open. The market-date (2026-09-29) close was $2.32. 20-day realized volatility is ~39% and 3-month ~53% annualized, but monthly moves since April have run ±20-35%.

Keep the mean. The 60.8M Class E warrants at $5.50 (exercise would raise ~$335M and add 26% to the share count) and the $28.9M ATM create supply above ~$5.5. Even so, the stock went from $0.4 to $11 in Dec-2024 and reached $8.71 within the last year, so ~6% is reasonable.

Getting there needs cash destroyed (Quantisimo/SAIQ-type transfers at losses, stake write-downs, related-party advances), a dilutive raise, or an abandoned PQC roadmap. agent_1's $1.50 is a reasonable early warning because it sits at bare forward cash per share.

PQC timing: the V1/V2 CC lab reports (Oct-26/Jan-27) are not certifications, EAL5+ certification is only targeted for '2027', the end-2026 QVault revenue line was dropped, and TPM-183/185 TCG are targeted for Feb/May-2027.

That is one analysis, not independent agreement, but I re-checked it in the primary filings and it holds. LAES is a shrinking cash box: ~$464M now, ~$355M (~$1.53/share) by Oct-2027, inside a WISeKey-controlled group moving cash and assets into SAIQ and Quantisimo. PQC revenue is an H2-2027 story at best, after the end-2026 revenue line was quietly dropped. Fair value is ~$2.10 against the $2.375 close, with a cash-supported left tail and a warrant-capped hype right tail. I keep the forecaster mean ladder (low confidence); the only real open question is the operating multiple.
